context: Riku and Aoi chat about a baseball game.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ねぇ/まぁ/ものの/秒/メンバー/野球) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: Hey, did you watch the baseball yesterday?
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Well, I only watched the second half.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最後の数秒で、逆転したんだ!
lines.en: They turned it around in the last few seconds!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えー、惜しかったものの、見逃したの。
lines.en: Aw, it was close, but I missed it.
lines.style: regretful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ねぇ、あのメンバー、すごいよね。
lines.en: Hey, that lineup is amazing, right?
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まぁ、確かに強いメンバーだね。
lines.en: Well, it's certainly a strong lineup.
lines.style: agreeable barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 残り一秒の野球って、最高だよ!
lines.en: Baseball with one second left is the best!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねぇ、次はメンバーで見ようよ!
lines.en: Hey, next time let's watch with the gang!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
